events.title: Playtest Version Updated
events.summary: Hi everyone! Thanks for all your support!We’ve just pushed some fixes for the ongoing Playtest:Fixed: Camera tilting issues caused by the forced camera movement when defeating enemies.Fixed: A bug that caused the game to soft-lock if the player was defeated during an aerial attack.Fixed: Barrels and treasure chests being targeted by the lock-on system.Updated: Tutorial images.A quick reminder that the Playtest runs until May 5th. Don’t miss out!
